note: Hand-curated. `confidence: recalled` = written from knowledge with a citation; `read` = the cited source was opened and the summary checked against it. scripts/check-sources.mjs stamps `reachable_at` when the URL answers; it never upgrades confidence — a person does.

instruments.title: Water Framework Directive
instruments.citation: Directive 2000/60/EC, OJ L 327
instruments.summary: River basin districts as the unit of water management; management plans on a six-year cycle (2009, 2015, 2021); 'good status' by 2015 with extensions to 2027; cost recovery for water services. Every basin plan in both countries descends from this.

instruments.title: Albufeira Convention enters into force
instruments.citation: Convention on Co-operation for the Protection and Sustainable Use of the Waters of the Luso-Spanish River Basins, signed Albufeira 1998-11-30
instruments.summary: Governs the five shared basins (Minho, Lima, Douro, Tejo, Guadiana): minimum annual flows Spain must deliver to Portugal, a joint commission (CADC), and exceptions in drought years defined by upstream rainfall. The 2008 revision protocol added quarterly and weekly flow minima (in force 2009).

instruments.title: Plan Hidrológico Nacional — the Ebro transfer
instruments.citation: Ley 10/2001, de 5 de julio, del Plan Hidrológico Nacional
instruments.summary: Authorised a 1,050 hm³/yr transfer from the lower Ebro to the Júcar, Segura and Almería basins and to Barcelona, plus ~900 listed works. The transfer was never built.
instruments.check: BOE ELI resolved to the named act, 2026-09-18

instruments.title: Protection of the cork oak and holm oak
instruments.citation: Decreto-Lei n.º 169/2001, de 25 de maio
instruments.summary: Felling of sobreiro (cork oak) and azinheira (holm oak) requires authorisation; land-use conversion of montado is restricted. The legal floor under Portugal's cork supply — roughly half of world production.
instruments.wall: diariodarepublica.pt is a JS application — verify in a browser, not from a script

instruments.title: Alqueva reservoir begins filling
instruments.citation: EDIA — Empresa de Desenvolvimento e Infra-estruturas do Alqueva; gates closed 8 February 2002, full storage level (152 m) first reached 2010
instruments.summary: The largest reservoir in Western Europe (4,150 hm³) on the Guadiana, feeding the Alqueva irrigation perimeter (≈120,000 ha by the 2010s). The physical cause of Alentejo's shift into intensive olive and almond after 2010.

instruments.title: CAP mid-term reform — decoupling
instruments.citation: Council Regulation (EC) No 1782/2003
instruments.summary: Single Payment Scheme replaces most crop-linked payments; cross-compliance. Olive oil, cotton and tobacco were folded in by Regulation (EC) No 864/2004 (olive payments decoupled from 2006).

instruments.title: Ebro transfer repealed — Programa A.G.U.A.
instruments.citation: Real Decreto-ley 2/2004, de 18 de junio (later Ley 11/2005, de 22 de junio)
instruments.summary: Repealed the Ebro transfer articles of the 2001 plan and replaced them with desalination and reuse along the Mediterranean coast (Programa A.G.U.A.). Spain became the EU's largest desalinator.
instruments.check: BOE ELI resolved to the named act, 2026-09-18

instruments.title: 2005 drought — national drought commission
instruments.citation: Resolução do Conselho de Ministros n.º 83/2005
instruments.summary: The 2004–05 hydrological year was the driest on record in Portugal to that point; the commission coordinated supply restrictions and farm support.
instruments.wall: diariodarepublica.pt is a JS application — verify in a browser, not from a script

instruments.title: National programme for efficient water use (PNUEA)
instruments.citation: Resolução do Conselho de Ministros n.º 113/2005
instruments.summary: Efficiency targets by sector; agriculture (≈75% of use) the largest. Revised as PNUEA 2012–2020.
instruments.wall: diariodarepublica.pt is a JS application — verify in a browser, not from a script

instruments.title: 2005 drought — exceptional measures, Júcar, Segura, Tajo
instruments.citation: Real Decreto 1265/2005, de 21 de octubre
instruments.summary: Administrative drought measures (well authorisations, transfers between users, tariff relief) in the Júcar, Segura and Tajo basins during the 2004–2008 drought; extended and widened by later decrees.
instruments.check: BOE ELI resolved to the named act, 2026-09-18

instruments.title: Lei da Água
instruments.citation: Lei n.º 58/2005, de 29 de dezembro
instruments.summary: Transposes the WFD: eight river basin districts (RH1–RH8), the ARH regional administrations (later folded into APA), water-use licensing and the water resources tax that followed (DL 226-A/2007, DL 97/2008).
instruments.wall: diariodarepublica.pt is a JS application — verify in a browser, not from a script

instruments.title: Water-use licensing regime
instruments.citation: Decreto-Lei n.º 226-A/2007, de 31 de maio
instruments.summary: Every abstraction, discharge and occupation of the water domain needs a title; the basis for counting irrigation withdrawals.
instruments.wall: diariodarepublica.pt is a JS application — verify in a browser, not from a script

instruments.title: Catalonia drought emergency 2007–08
instruments.citation: Decret 84/2007, de 3 d'abril (Generalitat de Catalunya); emergency phase for the Ter–Llobregat system 2008
instruments.summary: Barcelona's reservoirs fell to ~20%; water was shipped by tanker from Tarragona and Marseille in spring 2008. The central government approved an Ebro→Barcelona pipeline (RDL 3/2008, 21 April) and repealed it in June after the rains.
instruments.check: portaljuridic.gencat.cat ELI answered 200 (title is generic; act number in the URL)

instruments.title: Water resources tax (TRH)
instruments.citation: Decreto-Lei n.º 97/2008, de 11 de junho
instruments.summary: A volumetric charge on abstraction and discharge — the cost-recovery arm of the WFD in Portugal.
instruments.wall: diariodarepublica.pt is a JS application — verify in a browser, not from a script

instruments.title: Albufeira Convention — revised flow regime in force
instruments.citation: Protocolo de revisão do regime de caudais (Albufeira Convention), signed 2008-02-04, in force 2009
instruments.summary: Adds quarterly and weekly minimum flows at the border stations (Miranda, Saucelle+Águeda, Crestuma; Cedillo, Ponte de Muge; Badajoz, Pomarão) to the annual minima of 2000.

instruments.title: CAP 2014–2020 — greening
instruments.citation: Regulation (EU) No 1307/2013
instruments.summary: Basic payment + 30% 'green' payment (crop diversification, permanent grassland, ecological focus areas); coupled support re-allowed for sectors in difficulty; Spain and Portugal used it for rice, protein crops and nuts among others.

instruments.title: Tajo–Segura transfer — the 2013 Memorandum rules
instruments.citation: Ley 21/2013, de 9 de diciembre, de evaluación ambiental, disposición adicional 15.ª; Real Decreto 773/2014
instruments.summary: Sets the transfer's operating rule on the joint storage of Entrepeñas and Buendía: monthly transfers by storage band, a 400 hm³ floor below which no transfer is allowed. Murcia and Alicante's export horticulture depends on this pipe.
instruments.check: BOE ELI resolved to the named act, 2026-09-18

instruments.title: Second-cycle river basin plans 2015–2021
instruments.citation: Real Decreto 1/2016, de 8 de enero
instruments.summary: Approves the WFD plans for the Spanish inter-community basins (Cantábrico, Miño-Sil, Duero, Tajo, Guadiana, Guadalquivir, Segura, Júcar, Ebro and others) for 2015–2021.
instruments.check: BOE ELI resolved to the named act, 2026-09-18

instruments.title: Second-cycle river basin plans (PGRH 2016–2021)
instruments.citation: Resolução do Conselho de Ministros n.º 52/2016
instruments.summary: Approves the plans for RH1–RH8 (Minho e Lima, Cávado/Ave/Leça, Douro, Vouga/Mondego/Lis, Tejo e Ribeiras do Oeste, Sado e Mira, Guadiana, Ribeiras do Algarve).
instruments.wall: diariodarepublica.pt is a JS application — verify in a browser, not from a script

instruments.title: 2017 drought — urgent measures, Júcar, Segura, Duero
instruments.citation: Real Decreto-ley 10/2017, de 9 de junio (converted into Ley 1/2018, de 6 de marzo)
instruments.summary: Emergency measures for the drought in the Júcar, Segura and Duero basins: tariff exemptions, temporary transfers between rights, emergency works. 2017 was among the driest and hottest years on record in Iberia.
instruments.check: BOE ELI resolved to the named act, 2026-09-18

instruments.title: 2017 drought — mitigation measures
instruments.citation: Resolução do Conselho de Ministros n.º 80/2017
instruments.summary: Recognises severe/extreme drought across the interior and south; supply reinforcement, livestock water and feed support. The 2017 fire season (Pedrógão Grande, October fires) sits on the same rainfall deficit.
instruments.wall: diariodarepublica.pt is a JS application — verify in a browser, not from a script

instruments.title: Private storage aid for olive oil
instruments.citation: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2019/1882
instruments.summary: Opened tenders for private storage of olive oil after two large Spanish harvests drove prices below the trigger level — the market's own response to a good rain year.

instruments.title: Water Reuse Regulation
instruments.citation: Regulation (EU) 2020/741 (applies from 26 June 2023)
instruments.summary: Minimum quality classes for reclaimed water in agricultural irrigation — the legal basis for the reuse leg of the Mediterranean supply strategy.

instruments.title: Mar Menor recovery and protection law (Murcia)
instruments.citation: Ley 3/2020, de 27 de julio, de recuperación y protección del Mar Menor (Región de Murcia)
instruments.summary: Restricts fertiliser and irrigation practice in the Campo de Cartagena drainage area after the lagoon's eutrophication collapses (2016, 2019, 2021). Followed by Ley 19/2022 (30 September) giving the lagoon legal personhood — a first in Europe.
instruments.check: BOE ELI resolved to the named act, 2026-09-18

instruments.title: Algarve water-efficiency plan
instruments.citation: Plano Regional de Eficiência Hídrica do Algarve (APA / Governo, 2020); PRR-funded
instruments.summary: Loss reduction, reuse and a Faro desalination plant, after the Algarve's reservoirs (Odeleite–Beliche, Odelouca, Bravura) ran towards dead storage in the 2019–2023 drought. Citrus is the Algarve's irrigated crop.

instruments.title: Climate change and energy transition law
instruments.citation: Ley 7/2021, de 20 de mayo, de cambio climático y transición energética
instruments.summary: Net zero by 2050; basin plans must carry climate-change risk and adaptation; the water title obliges planning on foreseeable resource reduction.
instruments.check: BOE ELI resolved to the named act, 2026-09-18

instruments.title: CAP 2023–2027 — national strategic plans
instruments.citation: Regulation (EU) 2021/2115 (applies from 1 January 2023)
instruments.summary: Each member state writes its own CAP Strategic Plan; eco-schemes; Spain's plan includes an eco-scheme for cover crops in woody crops (olive, vine, citrus) on slopes, Portugal's for organic and integrated production.

instruments.title: Climate framework law
instruments.citation: Lei n.º 98/2021, de 31 de dezembro — Lei de Bases do Clima
instruments.summary: Climate neutrality by 2050 (target later brought to 2045); sectoral adaptation plans including water and agriculture.
instruments.wall: diariodarepublica.pt is a JS application — verify in a browser, not from a script

instruments.title: Nitrate pollution from agricultural sources — new rules
instruments.citation: Real Decreto 47/2022, de 18 de enero
instruments.summary: Replaces the 1996 transposition of the Nitrates Directive after the Court of Justice found Spain in breach (C-559/19 Doñana, 2021; C-576/22 nitrates, 2024). Tightens vulnerable-zone designation and action programmes.
instruments.check: BOE ELI resolved to the named act, 2026-09-18

instruments.title: Doñana irrigation regularisation bill (Andalusia) — withdrawn 2023
instruments.citation: Proposición de Ley (Parlamento de Andalucía) on the Corredor Verde / Condado de Huelva irrigation, tabled 2022 and re-tabled 2023; withdrawn after the Government–Junta 'Marco de actuaciones para Doñana' of 27 November 2023 (≈€1.4bn)
instruments.summary: Would have regularised ~1,500 ha of berry irrigation on the aquifer that feeds Doñana; the EU Court had condemned Spain over the aquifer in 2021. The compromise pays growers to retire land instead. Huelva's strawberries are the crop at stake.
instruments.note: The miteco press URL recalled for the 2023 Marco de actuaciones redirects to a 404; no stable primary URL on file — find the Consejo de Ministros reference of 27 Nov 2023.

instruments.title: PERTE for the digitalisation of the water cycle
instruments.citation: Acuerdo del Consejo de Ministros, 22 March 2022 (Plan de Recuperación); ≈€3bn public investment
instruments.summary: Metering, telemetry and leak control across supply, irrigation communities and basin authorities — the state's bet that measurement, not new reservoirs, is the next increment of water.

instruments.title: 2022 drought — restrictions on hydro and irrigation
instruments.citation: Comissão Permanente de Prevenção, Monitorização e Acompanhamento dos Efeitos da Seca — measures of 1 February 2022 and after; RCM 51-B/2022 (drought measures, 2022-06)
instruments.summary: Hydropower suspended at five dams to hold irrigation and supply storage; the Alentejo and Algarve in extreme drought for most of the year; 2022 the hottest year in Portugal's record to that date.
instruments.note: portugal.gov.pt news URL recalled is dead (404); cite the RCM number from DRE once verified in a browser.

instruments.title: Sustainable soil nutrition rules
instruments.citation: Real Decreto 1051/2022, de 27 de diciembre
instruments.summary: Fertilisation plans and a farm advisor for most holdings; slurry application rules. Part of the nitrates response and the Mar Menor aftermath.
instruments.check: BOE ELI resolved to the named act, 2026-09-18

instruments.title: Third-cycle river basin plans 2022–2027 — Tajo ecological flows
instruments.citation: Real Decreto 35/2023, de 24 de enero
instruments.summary: Approves the 2022–2027 plans. The Tajo plan sets minimum ecological flows at Aranjuez, Toledo and Talavera rising in steps to 2027, which mechanically reduces the water available to the Tajo–Segura transfer; Murcia and Valencia's governments and irrigators litigated.
instruments.check: BOE ELI resolved to the named act, 2026-09-18

instruments.title: Catalonia drought decree-law; emergency declared February 2024
instruments.citation: Decret llei 1/2023, de 28 de febrer (Generalitat de Catalunya); emergency phase for the Ter–Llobregat system declared 1 February 2024
instruments.summary: Statutory restrictions by drought phase (agricultural irrigation cut up to 80% in emergency); six million people under emergency rules from February 2024 until the spring rains of 2024 lifted the phase.
instruments.check: portaljuridic.gencat.cat ELI answered 200 (title is generic; act number in the URL)

instruments.title: 2023 drought — urgent measures for agriculture and water
instruments.citation: Real Decreto-ley 4/2023, de 11 de mayo
instruments.summary: ≈€2.2bn package: direct aid to farmers and stock-keepers, tax relief, tariff exemptions, emergency works, expanded reuse. Eurostat has Spain's 2022 olive harvest at 3,940 kt against 8,257 kt the year before; extra-virgin producer prices more than doubled into 2023 (the price series is in the market layer).
instruments.check: BOE ELI resolved to the named act, 2026-09-18

instruments.title: Algarve — drought measures, irrigation cut
instruments.citation: Comissão de gestão da seca do Algarve, February 2024 (Governo / APA): agricultural allocations cut by 25%, urban by 15%, golf and tourism by 15%
instruments.summary: The Algarve's reservoirs at ~25% after four dry years; citrus growers' water allocations cut for the 2024 season.
